defaults.title: Christmas Treasure Hunt
defaults.kicker: the elves have hidden a surprise for
rules: Solve the riddle and run to the spot
Find the next clue and keep going
The last clue leads to your surprise!
clues: I wear twinkly lights and shiny balls, I stand so tall beside the walls. Peek under my branches green!
Under the Christmas tree
I am cold inside and full of treats. Open my door for milk and eats!
In the fridge
Splish and splash, I hold the bubbles for your bath. Look inside me!
In the bathtub
Round and round I spin your clothes. Peek inside and see what shows!
In the washing machine
At night you snuggle under me, dreaming of Santa. Look and see!
Under your pillow
You wear me outside in the snow. Look inside where your toes go!
Inside a boot or shoe
Santa's favorite snack lives here. Lift my lid, your clue is near!
In the cookie jar
I am full of stories big and small. Look between my books along the wall!
On the bookshelf
Mom and Dad love to sit on me. Look under my cushions and you will see!
Under a couch cushion
Look at me and you will see the smiliest face there could be!
Taped to a mirror
Brr! I am colder than the North Pole. I keep ice cream nice and cold!
In the freezer door
I hang by the fireplace waiting for treats. Look inside me, from toe to heel!
In a stocking
Coats and jackets hang in me. Open my door and look and see!
In the coat closet
I hold your teddies, blocks and cars. Look inside, little superstar!
In the toy box
Brush, brush, brush, twice a day. Look by your toothbrush, hip hip hooray!
By the toothbrush
Last clue! Where do you hang your coat when you come in? Look there for your big win!
Behind the front door
defaults.final_note: Santa's elves are so proud of you. Your surprise is hiding:
defaults.letter_text: The elves have been very busy! We hid a special surprise somewhere in your house, but you will need to be clever to find it. Follow the clues, work together and do not peek at the end. Happy hunting!
